purpose: CPU simulation only: fixed-budget three-stage queue control with original ABC and Neuron Flow
input: Dropbox synthetic Flash Sale minute request counts; includes bots and retries; no real traffic
tail: 30 minutes at rounded median of first seven arrival counts
primary_metric: mean total unfinished work at end of each minute; equal weight per scenario and ABC seeds
constraints: same arrivals, capacity shocks and initial allocation for all policies; same action catalog and 5-minute warmup/8-minute dwell for adaptive policies; no hidden future data
flow_model: three sequential fluid queues; work can pass multiple stages within a minute; unlimited queue and no work dropped; no server or per-request latency claims
perturbation: arrival global scale uniform 0.85..1.15 and per-minute multiplicative noise 0.90..1.10; productivity per-minute independent uniform 0.9..1.1 of nominal; fault factor 0.35..0.60, starting minute 10 to 23 with end exclusive; shifting fault stage 0 [10,16), stage 1 [16,22), stage 2 [22,28)
baseline: static fixed; maxweight-like greedy catalog action maximizing delta dot currently observed backlog; zero if no positive gain; no lookahead
representative_trace: shifting_bottleneck seed 100; all three ABC seeds and both baselines, chosen before execution
workflow_fault: inject TransientAgentError on first attempt of ABC evaluation; verify successful retry and duplicate submission after runtime restart
limitations: one source trace and perturbations only; no external validity, cost or latency guarantees; no LLM, HTTP API, live autoscaling or true neural network
